name: Shiina Tomoko
source:
One of the problem children in the school that [url=/c95191]Souma[/url] attends.

She only thinks about ways to have fun in order to make best use of her time as a high school girl, a period that is short but also the most valuable time in one's lifetime.

She is fully aware of her breasts as her charm point, boasting how she will use them to get rich in the future.

She dreams of becoming a sexy actress.
